API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIIntermediate CA CertificatesIntermediate Cert Resource Generate Hsm Key Pair
Intermediate Cert Resource Generate Hsm Key Pair
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/intermediateCaCertificate/keyPair/:certId

Generates a HSM key pair for the custom intermediate CA certificate with the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
certId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the intermediate CA certificate.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
certId
int32

Unique identifier for the intermediate CA certificate

publicKey
string

Public key in the HSM key pair generated for the intermediate CA certificate

keyGenerationTime
int32

Timestamp when the HSM key was generated
